from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

target = np.array([0, 89, 173])  # approximate Ryanair blue
diff = np.sqrt(np.sum((arr[:,:,:3].astype(int) - target)**2, axis=2))
mask = diff < 30
ys, xs = np.where(mask)
if len(xs) > 0:
    # Filter to the area we care about (right side, middle of screen)
    keep = (xs > 800) & (xs < 1200) & (ys > 400) & (ys < 500)
    xs = xs[keep]
    ys = ys[keep]
    if len(xs) > 0:
        print(f"Dublin pill bbox: x={xs.min()}-{xs.max()}, y={ys.min()}-{ys.max()}")
        print(f"Center: ({(xs.min()+xs.max())//2}, {(ys.min()+ys.max())//2})")
EOF
